entries.claim: God, You wondrously created the dignity of human nature and restored it still more wondrously. Through the mystery of this water and wine, grant us a share in the divinity of Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who deigned to share in our humanity and, being God, lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit for ever and ever. Amen.
